001: Excuse me, could you tell me where the library is?
Go straight to the end of the street, and then turn right.
No, it's about a five-minute walk.
You're welcome. Have a nice day!
002: Could you tell me, please, how to get to the metro?
You need to go over there, around the corner.
And will there be a sign there?
Yes, you'll see a blue letter "M".
003: Good afternoon! I'm looking for a pharmacy. Is it nearby?
Yes, the pharmacy is across the street.
Is it that white building over there?
No, the white building is the bank. The pharmacy is next to it.
Oh, now I see it. Thanks!
Feel free to ask if you need anything.
004: Excuse me, I'm lost. Where is the park?
The park is very close. Go back, and then turn left.
Yes, exactly. And you'll see it right away.
Thank you so much for your help!
005: Could you tell me, is there a good cafe nearby?
Yes, there's a cafe on the next street.
And how do I get there?
Go straight, and then turn at the second turnoff.
006: Sir, do you know where the bus stops?
The stop is over there, near the store.
And which bus goes to the city center?
The thirty-fifth and the forty-second will work for you.
Thanks, you've been a big help!
No problem, have a nice trip!
007: Miss, could you tell me how to find the "Central" hotel?
It's very simple. Walk along this street to the square.
At the square, turn right, and the hotel will be on the left.
Got it, thank you very much!
008: Excuse me, I'm looking for the post office. Am I going the right way?
Yes, you're going the right way. The post office will be two buildings down.
Is it that tall gray building?
No, the post office is the yellow building with a sign.
009: Could you tell me where the restroom is?
Sure, there's one in the shopping center.
And is the shopping center far?
No, it's right behind this building.
No problem, feel free to ask!
010: Hello! How do I get to the train station?
The best way is by taxi, it's not very close.
And can't I take a bus?
You can, but you'll need to make a transfer.
Then I guess I'll take a taxi. Thanks!
You're welcome, have a safe trip!
